title: Byte-Pair Encoding Merges
learning_objectives: Count adjacent symbol pairs weighted by word frequency
Apply learned merges to segment a new word
hints: Keep `vocab = {tuple(w) + ('</w>',): c for w, c in word_counts.items()}`.
Pair counts: for each symbol tuple, add `c` to every `(s[i], s[i+1])`; best = `min(pairs, key=lambda p: (-pairs[p], p))`.
Write `_merge(symbols, pair)` scanning left to right, joining `a + b` when the pair matches.

failure_feedback.advice: Weight each pair by its word's count and append '</w>' to every word.
Merge left to right without overlapping: 'aaa' → 'aa', 'a'.
On ties choose the smallest pair: min(pairs, key=lambda p: (-count, p)).
Apply merges in the order they were learned.
